Therefore, whenever it is possible for each one of you, hasten ye to those cities and shine forth like unto the stars with the light of the Most Great Guidance.

[CANDIDATE]
The states of the northeast on the Atlantic coast, such as Maine, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New York, contain some of Our loved ones, but in certain cities of these states souls are still unenlightened, and know nothing of the teachings of heaven. therefore, if it be possible, hasten ye unto each one of these cities, and shed the radiance of the light of guidance upon them, even as stars.
